candidates.claim: For all n and operations, W_max*Q_max >= n.
candidates.quantifiers: universal n and all input bit words; worst-case upper witness n=2^12

candidates.claim: Every k reachable n-bit pinned/last observations require k*n independent fixed bits.
candidates.quantifiers: all legal one-coordinate SET incl no-op, exact bitmap-only responses at times (0,2,3), n=5

candidates.claim: O(P) scratch requires at least two full old PIN bitmap scans.
candidates.quantifiers: same F1 SET/PIN/AS_OF/GC history; P=1,C=17, speculative preverification stage allowed and paid

candidates.claim: Every failed F2 mutation incurs zero stage writes.
candidates.quantifiers: remote bitmap mutated after old SHA passed but before second pass completed; P=1,C=17

candidates.claim: Each additional reader PIN token requires a separately stored immutable full snapshot image.
candidates.quantifiers: both readers PIN same epoch0 before one SET creates epoch1

candidates.claim: F3-C is no more expensive than F2 on every metric and every adversarial history.
candidates.quantifiers: old bitmap SHA-invalid before first page request; P=1,C=17

candidates.claim: N-1 <= lambda+b+8P(W_pre+Q_after)+A is a new joint authenticated history lower bound.
candidates.quantifiers: exact deterministic encoding, fixed overwrite one bit, no free side-channel; no SHA security premise

candidates.claim: An asymptotically strict nonfactorizing joint authenticated-history lower bound exists.
candidates.quantifiers: UNSPECIFIED hard distribution, exact function, parameter family and proof reductions
